document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
This  time  you  realize  Charlie  is  talking  sense.  You  go  with 
Norman to Bernard’s tent to move the wretch to the canoe. 
When you throw open the flap, you discover Bernard is gone. 
His  tracks  lead  down  to  the  Hanninah  and  vanish  at  the 
riverbank.  Your  hasty  search  turns  up  nothing.  It  seems  he 
wandered away in his delirium and drowned.
Your group hurriedly packs the canoe.
